name: Aiko
source:
A quiet mage with an affinity for healing magic. Epic quests often kill off a party member to show how serious the situation is, and she’s afraid that might be her fate. Nevertheless, she joins the party to help Hayato.

[From [url=https://visualnoveler.com/ascendant-hearts]official website[/url]]
